other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction worker with a valid identity card.
Applicant must have worked as a registered construction worker for three consecutive years.
Benefits can be received only once.
The bicycle purchased under the scheme cannot be sold for three years.
Application must be submitted within three months from the date of purchase of the cycle.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 90% of actual bicycle expenditure or ₹4,000, whichever is lower.
